audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text named her R 'The Call of the Pack' — that is her W; the R is Hounds' Pursuit. spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] described W as a dash — W makes her untargetable and empowers the pack; her dashes are E Eviscerate and R. breakdown.cooldowns had no number; she was called he/his/him in eight fields; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Verified from kits: Q Darkin Daggers 9-7s, 900 range, blockable projectile, bleed-amp; W 26-18s untargetable pack-empower; E Eviscerate 11-7s dash that heals her packmates (anti-heal target — the flagged missing interaction); R Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s, 900-range lock-on pack dash, recast grants a shield, body-blockable by minions.
audit.corrected: Ability names fixed, W-dash references corrected to E/R, cooldowns written with real numbers, pronouns corrected, bleed bullets rewritten. Anti-heal already surfaced in report[8]; its 'his' fixed.

edits.before: This is Naafiri's spike, not yours: her R (The Call of the Pack) gives her extra packmates, a shield, and huge dash range, letting her all-in you or dive from a screen away. Play respectful at 6, hold E for the exact moment she R-dashes, and do not step up without flash or your stun ready. If you burn E early, her ult all-in likely kills you.
